objective: Run a deterministic source-level reproduction using pinned current F2 perception_fabric, perception_host_permissions and perception_capture_broker source. Build a valid effective host-bound permission snapshot and ObserveIntent, then model an external portal Session.Closed event that is not reflected into the immutable F2 snapshot. Test whether current validation and CaptureOwner acquisition can still succeed. This is deliberately not an XDG/PipeWire runtime test.
expected_information: If current source accepts the intent/owner after modeled native closure because closure is absent from all F2 inputs, the stale-revocation hazard is reproduced at source-contract scope and supports the E2 execution-lease handoff. If validation fails without any snapshot mutation, the E2 hypothesis is falsified or needs revision.
explicit_nonclaims: No actual XDG portal session is opened.
No PipeWire remote or physical sensor is opened.
No product source is modified by the experiment itself.
